title: Nutty Earthy Dutch Lemongrass Pancakes
description: Fluffy and earthy Dutch pancakes featuring lemongrass, perfect for a kid-friendly breakfast, these pancakes are dairy-free friendly and infused with the subtle flavor of lemongrass oil.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine lemongrass and sugar, blend until well combined and the lemongrass is finely chopped.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together almond milk, eggs, and lemongrass oil.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined, do not overmix.
Fold in the chopped hazelnuts and bruised lemongrass.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
